Leon Thorne: Accepted. I'll bring the timeline doc."},{"spec_id":"spec_0332","text":"Subject: LET'S ALIGN!! Indigo rollout cross-team huddle 🎉

Hey amazing people!!

I am SO pumped about where we are with the Indigo rollout across all Oakhaven Hospitality Group locations. Seriously, the energy right now is unreal!

I'd love to get everyone in one room (or one screen!) for an hour this Thursday, 2:00-3:00pm. That means kitchen ops, front-of-house, marketing, purchasing, and the GMs, so all 13 of you. Calendar invite incoming!

Here's what I'm thinking we'll cover:
- Yusuf Dorsey will share where the new menus landed at the downtown and harbor locations (spoiler: they're printed!)
- Aisha Kowalczyk will walk through the updated launch date list she sent last week
- Zoe Nakagawa has the final marketing calendar, which is already in the shared drive
- Rafael Brennan will confirm the supplier delivery schedule. Nothing is changing, but it's good to hear it out loud!
- Sam Uchenna and Vera Ferraro will give quick shout-outs on staff training completion numbers

I don't think we'll need to make any decisions. Everything's basically locked! I just think it's so valuable for everyone to hear it together and feel that alignment vibe. Being on the same page is everything in this business!

No prep needed. Just bring your enthusiasm (and maybe a coffee ☕).

Can't wait to see all your faces!!

Cheers,
Marcus
